settings.title: Fabric & Care
settings.body: Dry clean only. Cool iron on the reverse. Store on a padded hanger away from direct light to protect the drape.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.body: Complimentary tracked shipping on orders over $250. Delivered in 3–6 business days. Thirty-day returns on unworn pieces.

settings.title: Made to Measure
settings.body: This style can be drafted to your own measurements in our atelier. Lead time is approximately four weeks.
